lines.text: What do you usually do on Saturday mornings?
lines.speaker: Kai

lines.text: I shop for food, but I'm free after eleven.
lines.speaker: Sol

lines.text: Do you want to go to the market together?
lines.speaker: Kai

lines.text: I don't really like busy places.
lines.speaker: Sol

lines.text: What do you like to do outdoors?
lines.speaker: Kai

lines.text: I like riding my bike. Do you ride?
lines.speaker: Sol

lines.text: Yes. We could ride along the canal because it's quiet.
lines.speaker: Kai

lines.text: Okay. Let's go at eleven thirty.
lines.speaker: Sol
